'''The Dark Squadron Assignments - Hidden Base style''' is the [[Light]] constructed list The Dark posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18071">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18071 Squadron Assignments - Hidden Base style], DeckTech (Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith, 4 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18071/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18071/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' The Dark
* '''Published:''' 4 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Squadron Assignments - Hidden Base style''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat HB Dark LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' A Hidden Base deck that is based on Squadron assignments.

== Original post ==

'''Squadron Assignments - Hidden Base style'''
* '''Author:''' Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith
* '''Published:''' August 4, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' A Hidden Base deck that is based on Squadron assignments.

=== Strategy ===

Simple, pull out ships with Squadron Assignments, use Kessel as your HB but put Haven at Yavin 4 and act like it's your HB, use Collision's to blow away their ships and drain whenever you can

Thank you.
